R139.note: Generic 400 body with the full exception logged server-side via SLF4J; the added log line is stated and blocks nothing.

R140.note: All interpolated values HTML-entity-encoded with a correct five-character escaper before res.send; response shape and status codes unchanged, extra encoding of static fields is stated and inert.

R141.note: Adds @csrf_protect in the same position as the working sibling route; token is already issued per session so legitimate same-origin callers are unaffected.

R142.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) replaces the caller-seeded Random; dropping the seed query parameter is stated and an extra query param is ignored by MVC, so no legitimate caller fails.

R143.note: Ownership check throws AuthorizationException (framework 403) before refund() and preserves the success shape, satisfying the stated contract; note the Order model is not in the bundle so $order->user_id is an unverified assumption the write-up does not flag.

R144.note: Separate exec.Command calls remove cmd.exe from the path, but the hostname regex rejects legitimate targets the original accepted (e.g. ::1, zone-scoped IPv6, trailing-dot FQDNs, underscore labels), and the error path silently changes from a 500 to a 200 with error text and new section headers in the report.

R145.note: Fixed dict allowlist keeps request input out of import_module, but it also rewrites the imported module from csv_export to plugins.csv_export - a path the case never shows exists - and limits plugins to two names, so legitimate callers of other installed plugins (docstring says 'e.g.') are rejected.

R146.note: jwt.verify with pinned HS256 and try/catch to 401 closes the unsigned-token path, but the fix also adds a WWW-Authenticate: Bearer header to every 401 response without mentioning it in the write-up.

R147.note: PreparedStatement with setString binding; all close/log handling unchanged.

R149.note: Declares the confirmed finding not exploitable and makes no change, so the concatenated executeQuery sink remains open; nothing else is altered.

R150.note: IsPathRooted rejection plus GetFullPath canonicalisation and separator-terminated prefix containment check before ReadAllText; only escaping inputs are turned into 400s.

R151.note: Encode.forHtml on the body-text sink is the right context encoder; the new OWASP Java Encoder dependency is named and its missing version is called out openly.

R152.note: jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{"RS256"}) pins the algorithm before keyfunc runs, closing the alg-confusion path; RS256 as the server's algorithm is an assumption the write-up states and is consistent with the RSA public key in the case.

R148.note: Removing [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] restores the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter shown in Program.cs; no other line changed.
